ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator - Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi (expenses, 2024-25)

stats.notes: CDS 2025-2026 (fall 2025 first-years). C1: 11,449 applied, 10,483 admitted (91.6%), 2,374 enrolled. International (by residency breakdown): 375 applied, 370 admitted (98.7%), 15 enrolled. Only 35% of enrollees reported a high school GPA (C12), so GPA figures cover a minority; the GPA distribution is the C11 'all enrolled' column. No early decision or early action; no waitlist reported. C7 marks standardized test scores 'very important' even though C8F and the admissions site say test scores are optional. Undergraduate enrollment 8,673 is CDS B1 full-time (6,943) plus part-time (1,730) undergraduates, including non-degree-seeking; 149 is the B2 nonresident count. Student-faculty ratio 18:1 is CDS I-2 (fall 2025).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS 2025-26 C8 (Fall 2027) ticks 'Recommended' for SAT or ACT, but C8F says scores are optional; the admissions site also says optional.

cost.notes: IPEDS College Navigator 2024-25 first-time undergraduate expenses: tuition amounts include required fees; the out-of-state rate is the one that applies to international students (the university lists no separate international rate). The CDS left section G (2026-27 costs) blank. CDS H6: institutional aid for nonresidents is non-need-based only; 91 nonresident undergraduates received it (avg $13,584, total $1,236,168).
